They feed us this narrative about China and the United States working together to "consolidate unity" and build the Paris Agreement, but that is just a smokescreen for the real agenda of globalist control. Do not buy into the official story; this entire public dance is nothing more than coordinated manipulation to advance their hidden agenda while pretending to fight.
